services.desc: Eco tour at the speed of fun!! Duration 2 Hours About This tour has it all! Explore the harbor from the back of a jetski and learn about the history of the area. Then we'll see local ecology and biology firsthand with wild horses on Cumberland Island and even spot dolphins up close! Up to 3 people per ski as long as weight is under 450 lbs. blurb: Guests captain their own Yamaha Waverunner jet skis on guided tours lasting 1 or 2 hours. Tours include stops at historical points of interest and opportunities to see local wildlife such as wild horses, porpoises, and manatees. Safety instructions and a certified master naturalist guide are provided.
